integrity: Complete direct proof is supplied; seven independent explicit finite-ring enumerations and exact rank-two/three convolutions corroborate it. No external or independent audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: The stated distribution is proved for finite commutative local rings with square-zero maximal ideal and embedding dimension at least two, and Heisenberg symplectic rank at least one. It does not extend to arbitrary local rings with higher Loewy length. Bounded primary-text searches leave a residual risk of implicit prior character-sum or determinant-fiber implications.
title: Universal three-level commutator fibers of Heisenberg groups over square-zero local rings
